Description
Gorgeous Views 2-Bed 2-bath Home in Kerrisdale Welcome to 5425 Yew Street, a spacious and inviting 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offering approximately 1,356 sq. ft. of comfortable living space. Thoughtfully laid out with generous room sizes, this home provides an ideal balance of functionality, comfort, and style. The bright living and dining areas create a welcoming setting for relaxing or entertaining, while the well-appointed kitchen offers plenty of space for everyday cooking. Two comfortable bedrooms provide excellent privacy, with two bathrooms adding convenience for residents and guests. Ideally located in a desirable Vancouver neighbourhood, you’ll enjoy easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, transit, schools, and everyday amenities.

Welcome to the Mackenzie Green, these low-rise Vancouver townhomes were built in 2012 by Pantheon Developments Ltd. The location and the neighbouring community of Mackenzie Heights is a top notch. Exclusive collection of boutique Townhomes features include Inform European custom cabinets, Wolf stainless gas range, Integrated appliances, wide-plank engineered walnut flooring, Quartzite countertops, overheight ceilings, frameless glass shower enclosures, contemporary bathrooms, and high-ceiling spacious bedrooms. The ground floor also has an exclusive outdoor patio and the indoor has an office den area and a in-suite storage. This home is perfect for a small family. 1 parking is included in the rent, utilities are not included. This home does not have AC.

Make yourself at home in Vancouver's West End. This two-level townhouse pairs a garden patio and private rooftop terrace with a living room, gas fireplace and hardwood floors. Enjoy Robson Street shops and restaurants, Davie Village, and weekend plans at English Bay or Stanley Park. Approx. 1,192 sq. ft., 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms plus a powder room, quartz kitchen counters, maple cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, gas range, dishwasher and in-suite laundry. $5,500/month; available December 1, 2026. Unfurnished; minimum one-year lease; utilities extra. One off-street parking space included; no storage. Pets considered case-by-case. Some photos digitally decluttered. Contact David Siccia, Licensed Property Manager, Heller Murch Realty, 236-998-5841. https://davidsicciaproperties.ca

Downstairs holds the third bedroom, full bathroom, private laundry, and a large 4th bedroom (no closet) /could also be used as a rec room/office/ kids play area- the options are endless!

Welcome home to The Grafton, situated in the vibrant Yaletown area. This southeast-facing open-concept condo features laminate and tile flooring throughout and floor-to-ceiling windows that allow abundant natural light and fresh air to flow throughout the space. The living area features a cozy fireplace, while the spacious patio offers a lovely spot to unwind. The kitchen comes equipped with high-end appliances and marble countertops. Residents of The Grafton enjoy access to amenities including a rooftop garden and green space, a bike room, and a library. Nestled in the heart of Yaletown and Downtown, you’re steps from beautiful parks, the seawall, and some of Vancouver's most popular cafes and restaurants.

The residence comes with one parking spot and one storage locker. The Wall Center is located in the heart of Vancouver, making it easy for residents to access all that the city has to offer.
